meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 当你想把 Python 写的网站(Flask/Django/FastAPI)发布到 Azure App Service Linux 时,Claude 会自动创建缺少的资源、设置启动命令、上传代码,然后输出发布结果提示,且不验证。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等,或“deploy Python to App Service”触发。

howto.what_en: When asked to deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux, Claude auto-creates missing Azure resources, sets startup and build flags, deploys, and prints the post-deploy message. No post-deploy verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', etc., or ask to 'deploy Python to App Service'.
